item.title: CVE-2026-19868 SonicWall sonicos: An authentication enforcement vulnerability in SonicOS SSLVPN service may allow a user with valid credentials...
item.description: An authentication enforcement vulnerability in SonicOS SSLVPN service may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA). | CVSS 7.5 | Known exploited (CISA KEV, added 2026-11-06) | EPSS 0.6%
